name.zh: 风格化无柄游泳海百合

description.en: Small stemless cup and five bifurcating arm bases with delicate open branches. Original static child-friendly teaching art; not a scientific reconstruction.
description.zh: 无长柄小杯体、五条分叉腕基和开放细枝。原创静态儿童场景教学美术，并非严格科考复原。

sources.title: Virtual Collection: Class Crinoidea - Digital Atlas of Ancient Life
sources.notes: Group-level shell/skeleton form and explicitly named fossil specimens only. Modern specimens on the same page do not establish prehistoric occurrence. Original inventory verification: opened. This does not assert a new full source reading.

sources.title: Crinoids — British Geological Survey
sources.notes: Small stemless Saccocoma is described as free-swimming; this commission is static and makes no exact locomotion claim.

artistic_choices.en: Color, exact proportions, nominal dimensions, pose, simplified plate counts, flanges and fine anatomy are artistic. No third-party image/mesh/texture incorporated.
artistic_choices.zh: 颜色、精确比例、标称尺寸、姿态、简化板列、翼缘和细部为艺术处理；不收录第三方图像、网格或纹理。

scale.kind: art-direction choice, not a newly measured fossil dimension

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed stylized-inspired static teaching art. Color, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified fine anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的静态风格化启发教学美术；颜色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化细部属于艺术选择，并非严格科学复原。
